declarations.name: AuiBreadcrumb

inputs.name: items
inputs.description: Trail from the root to the current page (last item). Items without href render as text.

inputs.name: linkCurrent
inputs.description: Render the current (last) item as a link when it has an href.

inputs.name: maxItems
inputs.description: 0 never collapses. Otherwise (>= 2), longer trails show the first item, an expander, and the last maxItems - 1 items.

outputs.name: navigate
outputs.description: An unmodified primary click on a link. preventDefault stops native navigation so a router can handle it.

properties.name: expanded
properties.description: Read-only: Whether the user expanded a collapsed trail.

limitations: Collapsing is by item count (maxItems), not by measured width.
An expanded trail stays expanded until the items change.
